subject: SSO login failing for new employees
resolution_summary: Customer's SSO provider certificate had expired. Guided admin through certificate renewal and IdP metadata refresh in CloudDesk settings. Issue resolved after re-testing SSO flow.
steps_taken: Verified SSO configuration in workspace settings
Confirmed successful SSO login for all affected users

subject: Charged for unused seats after downgrade
resolution_summary: Customer downgraded plan mid-cycle but was charged for the full month at the higher tier. Issued prorated refund for the unused seats.
steps_taken: Reviewed billing history and confirmed overpayment
Sent confirmation email with refund details

subject: API returning 429 on batch operations
resolution_summary: Customer was using a synchronous batch strategy that issued 50+ API calls per second, exceeding the burst limit. Recommended async queue-based approach with exponential backoff.
steps_taken: Identified burst pattern exceeding rate limit
Shared rate limit documentation and best practices
Provided sample code for exponential backoff
